item.title: COMING Friday November 20th | Last Waltz – A 50th Anniversary Celebration — Fri Nov 6 — Pisgah Brewing Company Black Mountain
item.description:
November 20, 2026 8:00 PM | From $22.71 adv. Event Details and Tickets Hey everyone we are thrilled to announce that members of @cloudsofdelusionofficial and @sunsofstars are coming together to celebrate the 50th anniversary of The Last Waltz at Pisgah Brewing Company! Inspired by The Band’s legendary farewell concert at San Francisco’s Winterland Ballroom on Thanksgiving Day 1976, our local musicians recreate one of the most celebrated nights in rock history.
Founded in 2005, Pisgah is known for producing some of the most sought after craft ales in Western North Carolina. Pisgah Brewing Company currently operates the new indoor taproom with live music several days a week, plus our outdoor music venue in the summer and fall months with live music frequently on WNC’s premier outdoor music venue, the Pisgah Brewing Outdoor Stage. Be sure to come thirsty and ready rock! Check out our upcoming schedule at pisgahbrewing.com/events
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group Another one on the harder side of my usual hikes but we should have nice cool weather to keep us moving. This is a repeat of a hike I did earlier this year but we will go in the opposite direction and go to Walker's Knob instead of Graybeard Mtn. This is a rocky trail with some steep sections so please make sure you are capable of doing this hike. We should be rewarded with some spectacular views and hopefully the tailing fall colors. There will be some steep downhill sections. We will keep a moderate pace but stop as needed.

item.title: AYPROS Mug Club: WOODFIN COFFEE DEPARTMENT — Thu Nov 12, 8:30 AM
item.description:
Asheville Young Professionals (AYPROS) **Start your Thursday with AYPROS at Woodfin Coffee Department!**
If Pub Club is your after-work hangout, Mug Club is the morning version. Coffee instead of cocktails, a little caffeine before the workday, and the same easy chance to catch up with familiar faces and meet other young professionals from across Asheville.
For November, we're heading to Woodfin Coffee Department, a locally owned neighborhood coffee shop and bistro near Beaver Lake. Opened in 2026 by longtime neighborhood residents Lucy and Jared Crown, this welcoming spot serves coffee, breakfast favorites, locally made pastries, and more. It's a great excuse to explore somewhere new while making a few connections along the way.
Mug Club is intentionally casual. Leave your business cards at home, come as you are, grab a coffee and settle in for a little while. No program. No presentations. No awkward agenda. Just good coffee and good people before the workday gets going.

item.title: The Body of the Golem: A Life in Portraiture — Sun Nov 15, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Artist and writer Riva Lehrer brings together portraiture, Jewish tradition, disability, and the figure of the golem for the 2026 Phyllis Freed Sollod Memorial Lecture in the Mountain View Room of the Sherrill Center. Through art and storytelling, Lehrer explores who gets labeled “monstrous,” who has the power to define that label, and what becomes possible when people claim their own bodies and identities. This lecture is sponsored by the Center for Jewish Studies. The event is free and open to the public. Accessibility UNC Asheville is committed to providing universal access to all of our events.
